testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle orientation lock for a selected face: tmp/obk-save-navigation-pinned-20261115/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:255:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle orientation lock for a selected face ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And no model geometry is selected ✔ When the user opens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is unavailable ✔ When the user closes the menu and selects a visible face of the block ✔ And the user opens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is available ✔ When the user chooses Lock to Current Selection ✔ Then a lock indicator appears beside the orientation control ✔ When the user reopens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is checked ✔ When the user chooses Lock to Current Selection again ✔ Then the lock indicator disappears ✔ When the user clears the face selection and reopens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is unavailable
